'''Ash's Pikachu''' (Japanese: '''サトシのピカチュウ''' ''Satoshi's Pikachu'') is {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|EToP|Ash}}'s [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]] in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]].

==History==
===Indigo League===
[[File:Ash and Pikachu EToP.png|thumb|left|200px|Pikachu and Ash]]
[[File:Misty and Pikachu EToP.png|thumb|left|200px|Pikachu running to Misty]]
{{OBP|Ash Ketchum|EToP|Ash}} found Pikachu under the floorboards of his home, chewing on wires to eat the electricity. His [[Delia Ketchum|mother]] asks him to take Pikachu outside, but when [[Gary Oak]] taunts Ash about how he has not yet become a [[Pokémon Trainer]], Ash decides to keep Pikachu as his first Pokémon.

Ash has Pikachu battle a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Pidgey}} but it already fled to [[Viridian City]]. After finding Pikachu, Ash attempted to put it in a Poké Ball but Pikachu deflected the ball as it disliked being inside of them. While Ash was talking to {{an|Misty}}, Pikachu fled to a grassy field. It defeated a {{p|Spearow}} which caused a whole flock to come. Ash rescued Pikachu from the Spearow and was about to take it to a Pokémon Center until a {{AP|Fearow}} arrived. Ash's selfless act of protecting Pikachu caused Pikachu to respect Ash. Despite Pikachu's health being in critical condition, it was able to paralyze Fearow in one blast, giving Ash the chance to capture it. Ash and Pikachu both arrived at a Pokémon Center and Pikachu got healed up there completely.

[[File:Ash Raichu EToP.png|thumb|200px|As a Raichu, in a fantasy]]

At the [[Pewter Gym]], Pikachu battled alongside Fearow and {{AP|Caterpie}} against [[Brock's Geodude]] and {{TP|Brock|Onix}}, and won. Later on, when Ash is in a Gym battle with Misty, Pikachu is petrified by the sight of her {{TP|Misty|Gyarados}} and does not battle. However, despite not battling, Pikachu does attempt to get [[Ash's hat]] from Misty while Gyarados was sleeping but Misty distracted it with a [[rice ball]]. Sometime later, Pikachu battled [[Sabrina's Abra]] at the [[Saffron Gym]] and was easily bested by it. It then battled a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Haunter}} nicknamed the [[Black Fog]].

On their way to a [[Hidden Village]], Pikachu accidentally gets separated from Ash and the others while noticing a {{p|Squirtle}}'s shell. Pikachu and Squirtle both go to the Hidden Village in hopes of Ash finding Pikachu. After [[Damian]] arrived in the village, looking for his {{p|Charmander}}, Pikachu became determined to find Ash. It found Ash after going down a waterfall.

Pikachu gets exhausted after a {{pkmn|battle}} and rests up at a Pokémon Center. It wanders off after seeing {{pkmn2|wild}} Pikachu. The wild Pikachu accept Ash's Pikachu in their group after Ash's rescued a Pikachu with a flower on its head. {{TRT}} came by and stole the whole herd save for Ash's who came back and opened the Poké Balls they were contained in. Defeating Team Rocket, Ash's Pikachu planned to stay behind with the other members of its kind but chose to go with Ash when he and {{ashfr}} were leaving.

At [[Indigo Plateau]], Pikachu meets another Pikachu which belonged to [[Ritchie]] nicknamed [[Sparky|Chuchino]]. During Ash's battle with [[Jeanette Fisher|Jeanette]], it was the second Pokémon to battle her {{p|Bellsprout}}. Pikachu was unable to use {{t|Electric}} attacks on Bellsprout since Bellsprout used its roots as a ground. Bellsprout threw Pikachu off of its head and was defeated by Bellsprout's {{m|Slam}}. During Ash's battle with Ritchie, Pikachu was used to battle Chuchino after both {{AP|Squirtle}} and Ritchie's {{p|Butterfree}}, Happy, were both defeated at the same time. Both Pikachu used the same attacks against each other which also resulted in a double knockout.
{{left clear}}

===Orange Islands===
Several months later, Pikachu went to the [[Orange Islands]] with Ash and arrived at [[Valencia Island]] first. Ash bumped into [[three punks]] and his Pikachu easily defeated their Pokémon. Pikachu found a sick {{AP|Lapras}} being attacked by a group of {{p|Krabby}}. After healing it, Ash and Pikachu rode on Lapras.

At the [[Trovita Gym]], Pikachu battled [[Rudy]]'s {{p|Electabuzz}} and lost.

During Ash's battle against {{OBP|Drake|Orange League}}, Pikachu was the first Pokémon sent out to battle him, going up against {{p|Ditto}} first. After defeating Ditto, it was not used again for the remainder of the battle until [[Drake's Dragonite]] defeated Ash's Squirtle and {{AP|Charizard}}. Pikachu defeated Dragonite after crawling in its mouth and launched a {{m|Thunder}} attack, defeating Drake and earning Ash a spot in the [[Orange League]] [[Hall of Fame]]. 

==Personality and characteristics==
As in {{aniseries|PTS|the animated series}}, Pikachu was originally unwilling to [[Obedience|obey]] Ash, but after Ash protected Pikachu from a flock of wild {{p|Spearow}} and a {{AP|Fearow}}, Pikachu gained respect for Ash. After Ash defeats Brock, Pikachu is named '''Jean Luc Pikachu''' (Japanese: '''ジャン＝リュック ピカチュウ''' ''Jean-Luc Pikachu'').

Pikachu likes Misty and greets her enthusiastically whenever she appears, often ignoring Ash in the process.
